site.about:
Hey there! I'm a senior software engineer with 14+ years of experience in gameplay programming, augmented reality and audio software.

I'm particularly interested in product and experience design across interactive media, musical instruments and applications.

When I'm not coding, prompting or designing, I like to make quirky electronic music.

projects.title: FIFA 14
projects.summary: I was a software engineer on the C++ codebase at EA Bucharest, working in the Game Modes team.

projects.title: Zombie INTERN
projects.role: Game design, art direction, software development
projects.summary: Now hiring: Office Supply Intern at Company Incorporated. In this role you will carry stuff across a cramped open-plan office without bumping into anything. You’ll need steady hands and good spatial awareness. No experience or pulse required.

projects.title: RACE Yourself
projects.role: Game design, art direction, software development
projects.summary: Tiny car chase simulator with a twist: police cars follow you by copying your exact moves one lap later, so you have to plan routes and use quick reflexes to shake them off. Controls: swipe or tap to switch lanes, hold the big red button for Turbo speed, time rewind or firing weapons. Nine locations, sixteen vehicles, mines, missiles and a 70s cop-show soundtrack.

projects.title: Sector ESCAPE
projects.role: Game design, art direction, software development

projects.title: Springboard
projects.summary: Springboard is a rhythm platformer inside ROLI Learn. A seven-piece cartoon band hops across lava and ice, and each jump is a note of a real song  like "Jump", "Eye of the Tiger" or "Kids", played on the light-up LUMI keyboard. Hit the note on time and the critter clears the gap, miss and they fall. It teaches timing and note recognition to people who would never open a lesson.

projects.title: Superluminal
projects.summary: Superluminal is an arcade shooter inside ROLI Learn: asteroids and enemy ships fly at you, and the only way to shoot is to play the right key on the light-up keyboard. Every dimension is a key signature, asteroid waves arrive as scales and chords, and 144 levels take a beginner from single notes to two-handed finger patterns without ever feeling like an exercise.

projects.title: Sphere
projects.summary: Sphere is holo|one's off-the-shelf mixed-reality platform for industry: remote expert calls, 3D models pinned in the workspace, and step-by-step task guidance, all synced through one cloud back end. I was an XR software engineer on the headset apps, building for HoloLens and Magic Leap.

projects.title: BeatSpiral
projects.summary: BeatSpiral is an iOS groove box built around a "spiral" sequencer, allowing you to make and perform electronic music by rearranging the steps of four loops. I designed the app and wrote the audio engine and UI in Objective-C and C++, my first shipped music app.

projects.title: Airwave Player
projects.summary: Airwave Player is the instrument that ships with ROLI Airwave, a camera that tracks both hands above a keyboard and turns gestures into expression. It runs as a VST/AU plug-in or standalone, with a preset library and 3D visuals that react to every Raise, Tilt and Glide of your hands.

projects.title: L7
projects.summary: A 7-track stereo loop recorder with timestretching and automatic tempo detection, running on the Teensy-based M8 music handheld.

projects.title: LÖÖP BRÖTHER
projects.role: Instrument design, art direction, software development
projects.summary: VST/AU plugin with 97 classic Jungle breaks you can switch and layer intuitively by using a wholesome meme-inspired interface.

projects.title: ROLI Learn
projects.summary: ROLI Learn (launched as LUMI) is the companion app for ROLI's light-up keyboards: lessons, a 1,000-song library, chord and scale drills and arcade games, all driven by the keys lighting up under your fingers. I implemented musical notation support as well as its two integrated games, Springboard and Superluminal.
